name: Necai Sys
source:
[spoiler]Necai Sys was the second in command of the gang of thieves that were living near the Leazas Castle under the lead of Reichardt.

When Reichardt was killed, Necai abandoned the life of a thief and became an adventurer by taking jobs of the Keith Guild. Her birth year is GI0997, though she claims to be 20 when first meeting Rance in Rance 01.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.miraheze.org/wiki/Necai_Sys]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
[/spoiler]
